description: Schema for .mxagile/state/graph-state.yaml — tracks the current state of the MxAgile Artifact Knowledge Graph index. Written by build_artifact_index.py after each build. Read by graph_capability.py and lifecycle re-sync to determine freshness.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward compatibility. Current: 1.

provider.description: Which provider produced this index. Matches knowledge_graph.provider in .mxagile/config.yaml.

status.description: Current graph availability state. DISABLED: provider=none. MISSING: index file not found. BUILDING: currently being built. READY: index is current and valid. STALE: source fingerprint mismatch. FAILED: last build errored.

last_built.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful build.

node_count.description: Number of artifact nodes in the last successful build.

edge_count.description: Number of cross-artifact edges in the last successful build.

source_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of all indexed source files at build time. Used to detect staleness.

build_duration_s.description: Wall-clock seconds taken for the last build.
